frontmatter.title: VSCode for Polyglot Developers: Multi-Language Setup Without the Bloat
frontmatter.subheading: A practical engineering guide to configuring Visual Studio Code for PHP, JavaScript, TypeScript, Lua, Java, C, C++, Rust, and Python - conflict-free, performant, and maintainable.
frontmatter.excerpt: Learn how to configure VSCode for 9 programming languages - PHP, JS, TS, Lua, Java, C, C++, Rust, Python - avoiding extension conflicts and keeping your editor fast and maintainable.
